text:
Talia: quick heads-up — hit a nasty edge bundle + typings mismatch. default-importing the SDK factory in an ESM edge worker drops overloads and generics collapse to `any`.

Marco: ugh. minimal repro?

Talia: repro snippet:
```ts
// app tsconfig: module=ESNext, moduleResolution=NodeNext
import RedwoodDefault from 'redwood-sdk';
const client = RedwoodDefault(); // expected typed client, gets any
```

Jun: sounds like default-export interop + bundler rewrite. When esbuild/rollup produces a namespace wrapper, TS inference for overloads can break.

Marco: try `import * as Redwood from 'redwood-sdk'` — that preserves types in some setups but often fails at runtime on Vercel Edge with "Redwood.default is undefined".

Talia: exactly. locally `import * as` looks fine, but deployed runtime throws.

Jun: likely root causes: (1) package exports/types misaligned so TS picks a different entry than the runtime, (2) default-exported factory is fragile.

Marco: short-term consumer workarounds: 1) call factory with explicit generics `createClient<MySchema>()`, 2) switch to `moduleResolution: "Bundler"` experimentally. both are suboptimal.

Talia: long-term suggestions: add a stable named export `export function createClient<T = any>(...)` and keep `export default createClient` for compat; emit per-condition types under `exports` so TS and runtime resolve the same entry; add tests that `npm pack` the toolkit and install it into an edge sample and run the production esbuild pipeline in CI.

Jun: also note the `unknown` vs `any` default debate — flipping to `unknown` breaks ergonomics. keep `any` as the default generic for minor/patch stability, provide an opt-in `createStrictClient<T>()` for stricter types. Document the choice.

Marco: I'll open a PR to: add named export, update `exports` to include types per condition (import/require), and add a CI smoke that installs the packed tarball into the edge sample and runs the exact esbuild config.

SDK-Bot: CI job "edge-typing-pack-smoke" scheduled for branch fix/edge-typing — build queued.

Talia: thanks — filed issue #5274 with minimal repro and attached sample. will follow the PR and CI run.

Jun: one more thing: add a d.ts lint in the release pipeline that flags default-only factory exports so we don't regress.

Marco: +1. will include that in the PR. closing thread for now, will reopen if CI finds issues.
